entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A half-Fae half-human from Eldraine, son of Alyse and Oko, who adventures across Eldraine, Ixalan, Ravnica and Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Alyse
entities.description: Kellan's human mother, who made his enchanted coat and married Ronald.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie planeswalker, Kellan's father, who exploits him on Thunder Junction and was designed as an avatar for Oona's consciousness.

entities.name: Ronald
entities.description: A shepherd who married Alyse, Kellan's stepfather.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: A Fae Lord who gifts Kellan basket hilts, sets his quest against the witches and was also responsible for the Wicked Slumber curse.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A sleeping curse on Eldraine that Kellan is sent to end.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: One of the witch sisters, slain by Kellan.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A witch sister who revives Kellan, relinquishes her crown, and reveals Talion's role.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch sister captured at Castle Ardenvale and later part of Oko's gang.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A companion of Kellan on his quest searching for her brother Peter.

entities.name: Peter
entities.description: Ruby's brother, enchanted as the Wolf Knight until Agatha's death.

entities.name: Troyan
entities.description: A vedalken guide who leads Kellan and Ruby up the beanstalk.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A witch who captures Kellan and Ruby and escapes.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker who assaults Castle Ardenvale.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who appears in Eldraine and later with Oko's gang.

entities.name: Amalia
entities.description: A vampiric cartographer who befriends Kellan and accompanies him.

entities.name: Vito
entities.description: A vampire leading an expedition to free Aclazotz.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The ancient bat god of night defeated in the Core of Ixalan.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Leader of a Sun Empire expedition party at the Core.

entities.name: Ezrim
entities.description: An archon who leads the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the case under which Kellan investigates.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov leader who invites Kellan to Karlov Manor and is murdered.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who exposes Etrata and reveals the killer.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A Dimir assassin exposed at the party.

entities.name: Anzrag
entities.description: A Gruul god who rampages across the Ninth District and escapes containment.

entities.name: Oba
aliases: Oba, the central dryad of Trostani
entities.description: The central dryad of Trostani, revealed as the killer.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya entity whose central dryad Oba is the killer.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who takes Kellan on as a bodyguard and later frees him.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon who with Ral Zarek starts interplanar communication relays.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The Western plane where Oko runs a gang and plans to crack the vault Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Sterling Company
entities.description: The company whose headquarters Oko robbed and whose mercenaries Ral leads.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: A member of Oko's gang who helps Kellan escape.

entities.name: Nolan
entities.description: A scholar of ancient artifacts kidnapped by Oko's gang.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who infiltrates Tarnation with Kellan's group.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: A draconic outlaw whose fortress Tarnation holds Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: A legendary treasure vault on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who disguised himself to steal the vault's treasure.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Lorwyn's deceased faerie queen and Kellan's paternal grandmother who appears in his dreams.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane Kellan dreams of, where Oona awaits him.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Kellan's home plane.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane Kellan reaches through an omenpath.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Kellan joins the Agency.

events.summary: Fae Lord Talion calls Kellan, aged sixteen, and gives him the quest to defeat the witch sisters and end the Wicked Slumber in exchange for information about his father.
events.quote: Kellan was called to realm of the Fae Lord Talion

events.summary: Kellan slays Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron and rescues Imodane; the Wolf Knight is revealed to be Peter.
events.quote: Kellan slays the witch by pushing her into her cauldron

events.summary: Hylda revives Kellan after the Wicked Slumber, gives up her crown and reveals that Talion was also responsible for the curse.
events.quote: informing them that Talion was also responsible for the curse

events.summary: Kellan helps Will Kenrith subdue Ashiok at Castle Ardenvale so Eriette is captured, though Rowan escapes.
events.quote: Kellan helped Will subdue the planeswalker

events.summary: Kellan declines Talion's reward and learns from his mother that his father is the planeswalker Oko.
events.quote: where she revealed his father's identity as the planeswalker Oko

events.summary: Kellan enters an omenpath and arrives on Ixalan.
events.quote: He entered and found himself on the plane of Ixalan .

events.summary: Kellan and Amalia side with the Oltecs against Aclazotz and help defeat the god and his vampire minions.
events.quote: After helping defeat the god and his demonic vampire minions

events.summary: Kellan and Amalia go through an omenpath together to Ravnica.
events.quote: He was surprised when Amalia offered to accompany him, but had no objection, and they went through together.

events.summary: Kellan joins the Agency on Ravnica and earns high honors by stopping the god Anzrag.
events.quote: earned high honors by stopping the Gruul god Anzrag from rampaging across the Ninth District

events.summary: At the party at Karlov Manor Zegana is assassinated, and Kellan and Kaya help Proft apprehend Etrata.
events.quote: Kellan and the planeswalker Kaya Cassir assisted Proft in apprehending her

events.summary: Kellan and Kaya help return Anzrag to containment after he escapes.
events.quote: Kaya distracted the god while Kellan retrieved the capsule, and they returned him to containment.

events.summary: Proft reveals Oba as the killer; Oba attacks and Kellan is flung from the ceiling and discovers he can fly, before Trostani is subdued by Kaya and Etrata.
events.quote: After Trostani was subdued by Kaya and Etrata, Kellan returned to his desk at the Agency.

events.summary: Kellan takes a job with Niv-Mizzet and Ral's relay project bound for Thunder Junction, where Oko is said to be.
events.quote: He applied for the job and was accepted

events.summary: Kellan recognizes his father Oko on the road to Prosperity, disrupting Oko's shapeshifting and forcing him to flee the Sterling Company.
events.quote: crossed paths with someone whom Kellan immediately recognized as his father

events.summary: Oko lets Kellan join his gang, where he is shocked to see Eriette and Ashiok.
events.quote: Oko decided to let Kellan join his gang

events.summary: Oko's gang kidnaps the scholar Nolan from a train, and Oko abandons the train and its innocent passengers.
events.quote: Oko went back on his promise and ran away.

events.summary: Kellan grows magic vines to stall the train and save the passengers, and Annie helps him escape.
events.quote: Kellan managed to grow magic vines that stalled the train over the canyon, allowing the passengers to disembark

events.summary: At Tarnation the group is captured and Kellan challenges Akul to a duel.
events.quote: Kellan, searching for any way to escape death, challenged the dragon to a duel

events.summary: Sterling mercenaries led by Ral, tipped off by Oko, interrupt the duel; Oko steals the vault key and Kellan is knocked out.
events.quote: he saw his father regarding him with indifference as he left for the vault

events.summary: Ral frees Kellan from a Sterling prison wagon and Kellan agrees to help him take the vault's treasure.
events.quote: Kellan agreed to the plan.

events.summary: Ashiok paralyzes Kellan; the one who takes the treasure is revealed to be Jace in disguise and Oko planeswalks away from Vraska.
events.quote: revealing themself to be Jace Beleren in disguise

events.summary: Kellan fully accepts his fae heritage and mind-controls Akul into releasing Annie and entering the vault forever.
events.quote: ordering him to release Annie, go into the vault, and never come out

events.summary: Kellan declines Ral's job offer and Amalia arrives to map the plane with him.
events.quote: Ral showed up to check on Kellan and offered him a job on Ravnica, but Kellan declined.

events.summary: Kellan begins dreaming of Lorwyn and Oona appears to him, telling him she awaits him in Lorwyn.
events.quote: She told Kellan that she awaited him in Lorwyn.
